brief: Learns a decision tree over categorical features by ID3 and explains each answer as the path it followed.
detail: The tree splits on the feature with the greatest information gain and ends in the majority label. It is the most explainable learner of the module: Why narrates the exact path of the last classification, and ToGraph returns the tree as a real stzGraph that the rest of the library can query. Feature values compare without regard to case. A value never seen during training falls to the majority label of the node it reached, and Why says so. The build runs in the engine; the choices are deterministic, with the first feature to reach the highest gain winning a tie. Numeric features are treated as categories, so each distinct number is its own value.
